Recorded claim:
A direct `TreeView.rowCountsChanged(rowCountChanges)` test does not cover the C++ quick-search bridge, queue, animation-frame flush, or `endUpdateBatch`. The needed regression is a thread-pane body-search browser test that inserts rows above a selected message and proves the same message remains selected while search is active. [Task 1]
